0022600114.text: The Orlando Magic (0-1) visit the New York Knicks (0-1), with both teams still searching for their first win after one game each. Orlando sits 4th in the Southeast and 11th in the East, 1 game back in its division, while New York is 3rd in the Atlantic and 9th in the East, 1.5 games back. Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 before meeting in Orlando on December 13, 2025, when the Magic lost 132-120.
